$comment: Publishing standards per platform. Every number carries where it was read (source) and when (checked). Poster exports (meta.exports) and copy-length validation (3-write-copy.js) read this file; skills quote it instead of re-deriving.

feed_recommended.note: square fills the feed card; 4:5 (1080x1350) is the other recommended feed shape

landscape_link_preview.note: our landscape poster; shows with bars in the feed card

photos.aspect: 4:3 displays in full; first image is shown largest in a multi-image post

recommended.note: platform text: 推荐上传 3:4 或 2:1 之间，分辨率不低于 720*960，超过 1280P 用网页端上传更清晰

xiaohongshu.source: creator.xiaohongshu.com 上传图文 page text + editor counters

copy.description: plain text (no markdown); ~2.6k chars typed fine

portrait.aspect: portrait poster as-is; groups show a thumbnail, full image on tap

copy.hashtag_line: #接龙 must be line 1 for local groups (WeChat converts it into a 接龙 thread); never for the nationwide group

banner.aspect: landscape poster; Teams webinar cover is optional
